nodes.label: Graphify Skill Reference
nodes.rationale: Instructs Claude to load the installed graphify skill (.claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md) or its instructions before doing anything else whenever the user types /graphify, giving a consistent entry point into the project's knowledge-graph tooling.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: When graphify-out/graph.json exists, Claude must run graphify query/path/explain before the first grep, search, or source-file read for a codebase question, because these return a scoped subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, cutting token cost versus full source browsing. Raw files are read only for lines the graph (or an earlier read) already located. After code changes, graphify update . keeps the graph current via AST-only parsing (no API cost). Because graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, large diffs to it are expected and must not be flagged as churn.
